bullets.text: The AAdvantage financing is secured by a first-priority security interest in various agreements related to the AAdvantage program, including all payments under those agreements, and certain intellectual property licenses.

The collateral also includes certain deposit accounts that receive cash from the AAdvantage agreements, certain reserve accounts, the equity of Loyalty Issuer and SPV Guarantors, and substantially all other assets of Loyalty Issuer and the SPV Guarantors.
Additionally, American's rights to certain data and other intellectual property used in the AAdvantage program (with some exceptions) are part of the AAdvantage Collateral.
